name: cairina moschata heart/liver autolysate
purpose: Purpose Anas barbariae ....... To reduce the duration and severity of flu-like symptoms.*
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves flu-like symptoms such as: • body aches • headache • fever • chills • fatigue
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use in children under 2 years of age Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 3 days or worsen.
